purpose: Assess only whether to promote the validated and productivity-eligible L03 activity-utterance candidate to scoped productivity inside controlled Binah activity contexts.

promotion_proposals.subject: SCOPE
promotion_proposals.boundary: No extension to other lessons or contexts.

promotion_proposals.subject: REALIZATIONS
promotion_proposals.boundary: No new forms or functional tokens.

promotion_proposals.subject: GRAMMATICAL_LIMITS
promotion_proposals.boundary: Productivity applies only to contextual completeness of the listed activity lexemes.

promotion_proposals.subject: CURRICULUM_DEPENDENCY
promotion_proposals.boundary: Productivity promotion does not map or author curriculum.

promotion_proposals.subject: NEXT_STEP_IF_PROMOTED
promotion_proposals.boundary: Do not map slots under the productivity approval.
